name: deepresearch
author: agentic-labs
desc: Autonomous deep research agent that crawls the web, synthesizes sources, and produces structured reports with inline citations.

name: codeweaver
author: autonomous-dev
desc: Full-stack coding agent. Reads your repo, plans changes across files, writes tests, and opens a pull request.

name: data-scout
author: mlops-collective
desc: Drop a CSV or connect a database. Profiles your dataset, identifies patterns, runs statistical tests, and generates interactive visualizations.

author: cloudops-agents
desc: Connects to AWS/GCP/Azure, watches metrics and logs, correlates anomalies across services, and can auto-scale or rollback with approval.

name: market-pulse
author: fintech-agents
desc: Tracks SEC filings, earnings calls, and news sentiment in real time. Generates daily briefings and alerts on significant moves.

name: customer-agent
author: supportflow
desc: Ingests your knowledge base, answers common questions, creates tickets for complex issues, and escalates to humans when confidence is low.

name: legal-reviewer
author: contract-ai
desc: Parses contracts, flags non-standard clauses, compares against your playbook, and suggests redline edits.

desc: Handles Markdown, MDX, and HTML documentation. Preserves code blocks untranslated, maintains internal link structure, supports 40+ languages.

name: sql-writer

name: meeting-scribe

desc: Joins your calls, produces structured meeting notes with action items, decisions, and follow-ups. Integrates with calendar and Slack.

name: financial-advisor
author: merendamattia
desc: Personal financial AI agent. Analyses your income, expenses, and investments — then gives actionable advice, forecasts, and budget plans powered by LLMs.
